messages:
marta: Quick thread to capture a few edge cases for the v1->v2 migration doc. Found from support: 1) positional model arg in old SDKs, 2) webhook callback format change, 3) clients that block redirects. Draft: https://redwood.dev/r/5371

kai: Good call. For positional args we should show explicit snippet that compat maps `create('name')` -> `create({name:'name'})` but only when the SDK can be certain. Document the ambiguous cases where we won’t auto-translate.

olga: Webhooks: v2 payload adds `model_version` field and changes `id` typing. We must warn integrations that rely on exact JSON paths. Add a migration note and sample diff in the guide.

infra-bot: Staging redirect behavior: POST -> 307, GET -> 301. Redirect preserves method, body, headers except some custom auth headers which were fixed in patch 7c3. Querystring order preserved.

marta: Can we include a tiny code example for the TS SDK showing compat vs explicit v2 usage? Also show how to opt out of following redirects in curl to illustrate the failure mode.

kai: TS snippet suggestion:
```ts
// recommended
const c = new Redwood({ apiVersion: 'v2' });
await c.models.create({ name: 'x' });
// compat (temporary)
const old = new Redwood({ compat: true });
await old.models.create('x'); // shim logs warning and translates
```
Add a short note: compat logs to telemetry and to console once per session.

olga: curl example to show non-following case:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -d '{"name":"x"}' --no-follow
# -> 307 Location: /v2/models
#    X-Redwood-Deprecated: v1
```
Explain that some HTTP clients (eg, older mobile SDKs) may not auto-resend the POST; recommend updating client or enabling compat.

marta: I'll add a small FAQ entry: "My integration expects old webhook payloads" with steps: 1) pin compat model mapping, 2) update webhook parser, 3) contact support for a soft-landing window.

docs-bot: PR #5371 created by @marta in docs-staging. Please review snippets and FAQ.

kai: one last: include a tiny matrix of what the shim will and won't translate (positional args, simple string -> object mapping vs nested structured payloads). That will reduce support back-and-forth.

marta: agreed. I'll incorporate the matrix and request a quick review tomorrow 9am PT. Thanks all.
